name: DS Cluster S10e: Typed Resample Variants (Numeric/Boolean/Timestamp)
description: Tests: resample() dispatches to downsample_{number,boolean,timestamp} and upsample_{number,boolean} based on input type. Verifies the typed-variant resolver and runtime agg validation work end-to-end across all supported types.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10e: Typed Resample Variants
# =============================================================================
# Verifies that resample() now works on Boolean and Timestamp series,
# not just numeric. Each variant dispatches through GenericFunctionResolver to
# the matching downsample_<type> / upsample_<type> transform.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ts = index().value  # Timestamp series

# === Numeric resample (baseline — downsample_number) ===
weekly_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Last"])
monthly_avg = resample(close, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Mean"])

# === Boolean downsample — downsample_boolean ===
# 'Is Friday?' daily flag → weekly 'did any Friday occur?' (always true in a 5-day week)
is_friday = day_of_week(weekday="Friday")
weekly_had_friday = resample(is_friday, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Any"])

# 'Is Monday?' → weekly 'are ALL days Mondays?' (always false)
is_monday = day_of_week(weekday="Monday")
weekly_all_monday = resample(is_monday, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["All"])

# === Timestamp downsample — downsample_timestamp ===
# Resample the daily bar timestamp to weekly (last daily bar timestamp per week).
# This is the I5-036 pattern — controls compute grid timeframe explicitly.
weekly_bar_ts = resample(ts, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Last"])

# === Boolean upsample — upsample_boolean ===
# Upsample weekly_had_friday back to daily via ffill (carry value through the week)
friday_flag_daily = resample(weekly_had_friday, target_timeframe=1D, how="ffill")

# === Numeric downsample with mixed aggs ===
weekly_high = resample(src.h, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Max"])
weekly_low = resample(src.l, target_timeframe=1W, agg=["Min"])

# === REPORTERS ===
# Numeric reporter (xy_lines handles tuple y_values via auto-unwrap)
xy_lines(
    title="Weekly Close: Last vs High vs Low",
    category="Typed Resample",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Weekly Last", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Weekly High", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Weekly Low", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(weekly_close, weekly_high, weekly_low))

xy_lines(
    title="Monthly Avg Close",
    category="Typed Resample",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Monthly Mean", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=monthly_avg)

# Sink the boolean + timestamp + upsample outputs so the typed variants are
# actually executed in the runtime (not pruned as dead code).
cards(
    category="Typed Resample",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Weekly Bool Flags", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Any Friday", card_agg=AggregationType.Any, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(weekly_had_friday)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Weekly All-Monday Flag", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="All Monday", card_agg=AggregationType.All, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(weekly_all_monday)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Weekly Bar Timestamp", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Last Bar TS", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat)
    ])
)(weekly_bar_ts)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Daily Carry (Upsampled Friday Flag)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Daily Flag", card_agg=AggregationType.Any, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(friday_flag_daily)
